properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the daemon recorded its store in the rendezvous AS TYPED (`.reflow2/graph`), and every reader resolved that relative path against its OWN cwd, so from outside the project it named a different store and the running server was taken for another design's
properties.source: dev_reflow2 hub session, root-cause skill run in worktree reflow2-wt-shared-path, branch fix/shared-attach-by-any-path-spelling
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL, 2026-09-22.
① OBSERVED: from the dev_reflow2 hub folder, `--shared --graph-path <absolute path to a child's store>` served only reflow2_unavailable after 30 s, while the child's server was up; from inside the child's folder with its relative path, it attached.
② PRECEDENT: searched on the raw error texts. None for this failure. The nearest, fact:an-orphaned-serve-shared-daemon-holds-the-store-and-475mb-2026-09-13, was a WITHDRAWN misdiagnosis also involving relative paths.
③ CANDIDATES: (A) is_for_this_graph resolves a relative recorded path against the reader's cwd; (B) should_reelect judged a build mismatch; (C) the liveness probe failed; (D, outside the reader) the writer records the path as typed; (E) the observation is wrong.
④⑤ DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT, taken against the hub's OWN server so no one else's store was touched: from an unrelated folder the client logged the "belongs to a DIFFERENT design … recorded=.reflow2/graph" warning. A is confirmed. B is refuted (no "replacing" line, and the server survived); C and E are refuted (no probe was reached). D is A's other half.
⑥ CLASS: a record read by OTHER processes stored a path whose meaning depends on the WRITER's cwd. shared.rs's own comment already claimed "the rendezvous records what that resolved to"; the writer never did, so the documented intent and the code had drifted. It would also have hit any script, tool or second checkout outside the project, not only a hub.
⑦ PINNED, OBSERVED FAILING FIRST: unit test a_relative_record_is_read_against_the_servers_folder_not_the_readers FAILED with the old comparison (shared.rs:1015) and passes with the fix. The end-to-end tools/test_shared_attach_from_another_folder.py FAILED with only the writer line reverted ("the daemon recorded its store as '.reflow2/graph'") and passes with it restored (attach in 0.11–0.16 s, 189 tools). Regression cover: all 25 shared-module unit tests; test_export_to_reaches_the_daemon, test_degraded_server and test_shared_sessions (9 tests) pass.
⑧ FIX AT THE CAUSE: the daemon records `resolved_graph_path(..)`, absolute and canonical. For daemons still running an older build, a relative record is resolved against the SERVER's cwd (/proc/<pid>/cwd on Linux), falling back to the old behaviour elsewhere. The legacy copied-project guard is pinned too.
⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: non-Linux readers of an OLD daemon's relative record keep the old behaviour until that daemon is replaced by a current build; nothing was measured on macOS.
